title: Cost and price fields show only to a user who can see financial data
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a second browser, or a private window, signed in at the test location as user B, whose role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Part Library & Inventory → Create & Edit' and 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' but not See Financial Data.
  • Have a tracked part, part A, at the test location.
  • Start in both browsers on the Inventory page, on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. In browser 1, type part A's part number in the Search box.
  2. In browser 1, click the part A row.
  3. In browser 1, click Cancel.
  4. In browser 2, as user B, type part A's part number in the Search box.
  5. In browser 2, click the part A row.
  6. In browser 2, click the Track quantities and cost of goods switch.
  7. In browser 2, click the switch again.
  8. In browser 2, click Cancel.
  9. In browser 2, click New Inventory Part.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part A is listed in browser 1.

Step 2:

  • The Admin sees Average Cost, Sell Price and Core Charge in Edit Inventory Part.

Step 3:

  • The window closes.

Step 4:

  • Part A is listed in browser 2.

Step 5:

  • User B sees no Average Cost, Sell Price or Core Charge field; Description, Part Number, Vendor and Category show as for the Admin.

Step 6:

  • Min and Max disappear.

Step 7:

  • Min and Max show again.

Step 8:

  • The window closes without saving.

Step 9:

  • User B sees no Cost, Sell Price or Core Charge field in New Inventory Part; Description, Part Number, Vendor and Category show.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog)

  • S13-R4a: “Vendor always shows. Cost, Average Cost, Sell Price and Core Charge show only to a user who can see financial data. Min and Max show only while tracking is on (S4-R5).”
